title: Internship in Spain
text: Fondo pendiente: papagnoc-valencia-1049389_1920.jpg Your Internship in Spain Why Choose Spain for Your Erasmus+ Mobility Traineeships Spain offers one of the most complete environments in Europe for practice-based learning in sport and outdoor education. Your trainees will learn, practise and grow alongside qualified professionals in real professional environments. What makes Spain different Highly specialised sport and outdoor adventure companies Full integration into real, multicultural professional teams Structured hands-on learning under professional supervision from day one Opportunity to develop Spanish language skills in an authentic setting Safe, quality-compliant host organisations aligned with Erasmus+ standards Where your trainees will learn and practise Our partner host organisations are outdoor adventure companies — activity centres where trainees take on the role of sport monitors in practice alongside groups of children and young people. Trainees always carry out activities under the direct supervision of a qualified instructor. They will assist, learn from and collaborate with experienced monitors while gaining practical skills in activities such as: Hiking and mountain trails Mountain biking routes Rock climbing and abseiling Archery Zip lines and high ropes courses Kayaking and canoeing Paddle surfing and swimming Horse riding excursions Team games, group dynamics and outdoor challenges This is structured, mentored learning. From their first week, trainees support activities with children, developing leadership, communication and coaching skills — always with a professional by their side to guide and supervise them. Main destination: Valencia Valencia and its metropolitan area are among the most attractive destinations in Europe for Erasmus+ mobility — and one of the best cities in the world to live in. One of the best cities in the world to live in — Forbes 2024–2025 Top quality of life ranking — InterNations Expat Insider 2025 Over 300 days of sunshine per year Active, multicultural city with a strong sports culture Surrounded by nature — mountains, rivers and Mediterranean coast within 30 minutes Real immersion in Spanish and English-speaking professional environments Safe, dynamic and trainee-friendly city For a VET sport trainee, Valencia is not just a destination — it is a professional springboard. title: Erasmus+ Resources and Documentation
text: Fondo pendiente: slider25.jpg Erasmus+ Resources and Documentation Useful links and official documentation Everything you need to prepare your Erasmus+ mobility project in a clear and structured way. We know that documentation is a key part of any Erasmus+ project. That is why we provide you with the main official resources and support you in their correct management throughout the entire process.” Erasmus+ Programme Guide 2026 Official guide of the Erasmus+ Programme https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/document/erasmus-programme-guide-2026 Guide to working with support organisations in KA1 VET mobility Within the Erasmus+ Programme, National Agencies in each participating country define and regulate the role of support organisations (also referred to as intermediary organisations) in KA1 learning mobility , particularly in the field of Vocational Education and Training (VET) . This role is explicitly addressed in the Erasmus+ Programme Guide, in the section: “Accredited projects for mobility of learners and staff in vocational education and training” (page 96 of the 2026 English version), where it explains how these organisations can act as accredited partners or collaborators in mobility projects for learners and staff. The official guide establishes the general conditions for the participation of support organisations, including quality requirements, accreditation, and coordination with the beneficiary organisation (sending organisation). Link to Erasmus+ Programme Guide (2026 edition, English version): https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/sites/default/files/2025-11/programme-guide-2026_en.pdf For country-specific requirements, it is recommended to consult the relevant Erasmus+ National Agency: https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/contacts/national-agencies Learning Agreement A Learning Agreement defines the expected learning outcomes of a mobility period, how these outcomes will be achieved, and the roles and responsibilities of the participant, the sending organisation , and the host organisation . It is a key document to ensure quality and to create transparency and trust between all parties involved in a mobility activity. https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/resources-and-tools/mobility-and-learning-agreements/learning-agreements Europass Mobility Official template used to certify learning outcomes and competences acquired during Erasmus+ mobility periods (including VET internships abroad). It is recommended for post-mobility recognition and is currently undergoing digitalisation (EDC 2025–2026). Main link: https://europass.europa.eu/en/europass-mobility User guide: https://europass.europa.eu/system/files/2024-10/EM%20template%20-%20User%20guidance%20.pdf Erasmus Quality Standards Organisations implementing mobility activities must comply with a common set of Erasmus quality standards. These standards apply to the period 2021–2027 and are designed to: Ensure a high-quality mobility experience Guarantee meaningful learning outcomes for participants Ensure that all funded organisations contribute to the programme objectives This document includes: Core principles Good management practices Guidelines on providing quality and support to participants Recommendations on sharing results and knowledge https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/es/document/erasmus-quality-standards-mobility-projects-vet-adults-schools Verify our official OID As a registered support organisation in the Erasmus+ and European Solidarity Corps platform, we hold an official Organisation ID (OID), which you can verify directly through the European Commission’s tool. This confirms that we meet the European requirements to collaborate in KA1 VET mobility projects . You can search for our legal name: Move Abroad Experience or enter our OID directly: E10410987 Official search tool: https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/erasmus-esc/index/organisations/search-for-an-organisation Would you like us to help you organise your next Erasmus+ mobility project? title: About us
text: Fondo pendiente: escritorio-de-trabajo.jpg About us Erasmus+ and Turing Scheme Mobility Project Management in Spain We are a company specialised in the management of international educational projects within the Erasmus+ and Turing Scheme framework. We support Vocational Education and Training (VET) providers from different European countries and UK in organizing Erasmus+ and Turing Scheme mobility projects in Spain, managing all aspects that can be delegated to a support organisation within the Erasmus+ and Turing Scheme Programme. We streamline the entire process for the sending organisation and provide local support throughout the whole mobility period. We work on a small-scale, personalised basis , ensuring close support for every project. We act as a support organisation , facilitating management and ensuring compliance with Erasmus+ and Turing Scheme quality standards. PROGRAMME COORDINATOR IN SPAIN My name is Alberto Sabater and I am the Programme Coordinator at Internship Spain. For over 15 years, I have worked as a Physical Education teacher, a significant part of that time within Vocational Education and Training (VET) in the field of sport, where I have been directly involved in the organisation and supervision of student work placements. Throughout this period, I have supported hundreds of students, gaining in-depth insight into how mobility programmes operate from within, as well as a clear understanding of the real needs of both educational institutions and learners. My perspective is grounded in hands-on experience, having been in the same position you are now—as a teacher responsible for organising internships. In addition, I bring experience in international mobility programmes, having managed close to 400 participants in programmes in the United States. This has enabled me to develop a practical approach to managing students abroad, handling unforeseen situations, and ensuring continuous monitoring throughout the entire mobility period. At Internship Spain, I personally coordinate each project implemented in Spain. This ensures that both the sending institution and the participants benefit from direct, approachable and continuous support throughout the entire mobility experience. OUR EXPERIENCE Our team combines solid expertise in both education and international mobility management. Some members have more than 15 years of experience in the educational sector, particularly in VET in sport, supporting hundreds of students during their work placement periods. We understand how educational institutions operate internally, we are aware of teachers’ responsibilities, and we fully recognise what it entails to send students abroad. We also have a well-established track record in international mobility and cultural exchange programmes, providing us with a global perspective and extensive experience in participant management, support, and safety in international contexts. OUR WORKING APPROACH We are not a traditional agency. We act as a supporting organisation for educational institutions: We listen carefully to your needs We design tailored solutions We coordinate every phase of the mobility We provide continuous support before, during and after the mobility MORE THAN A MOBILITY EXPERIENCE An Erasmus+ and Turing Scheme mobility is not just a work placement abroad. It is a comprehensive experience that combines professional learning, personal development and cultural immersion. We take care of the full project organisation, including accommodation, logistics, coordination and ongoing support, ensuring a safe, well-structured and high-quality mobility experience. OUR COMMITMENT We work with professionalism, constant communication, a close and personalised approach, and strong attention to detail. Our objective is to ensure that every project is implemented with clarity, safety and trust for both the educational institution and the participants. Our goal is to become your trusted partner in the organisation of Erasmus+
